name: mrakdown-codemirror-bundle
description: Builds web/codemirror.js, the CodeMirror 6 editor used by Live mode. Run: npm ci && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=none --target=es2022 --banner:js="/*! CodeMirror 6 (codemirror.net) and Lezer, MIT License, (c) Marijn Haverbeke and others. Bundled for MRAkdown from tools/codemirror. */" --outfile=../../web/codemirror.js
